title: Classes and Reference Types knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Skip type checking and accept any result.
Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
The main goal is to apply declaring classes in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use classes and reference types only for visual styling.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply declaring classes in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Classes and Reference Types is best learned through a small, verifiable example. Classes provide reference identity and support inheritance. Shared references require clear ownership and lifetime rules to avoid unexpected mutation or retained objects.

Force all values through unsafe operations.
Ignore ownership and errors when an example works once.
